summary: Iteration 16 — 'Beri Ulasan Lebih Mudah' review-with-photo + reminders/nudges. BACKEND: 7/7 pytest passed against public preview (/app/backend/tests/test_review_with_photo.py). POST /api/orders/{id}/review correctly accepts and persists {rating, komentar, foto_url} — validated end-to-end (POST → GET). Regressions verified: review WITHOUT foto_url (null) still works, invalid rating 0/6/-1 → 400, unknown order → 404, non-owner (admin) → 403. GET /api/products/{id}/reviews items now include foto_url (both non-null and null cases). FRONTEND: pesanan-saya nudge-review-<id> visible on the selesai order without review ✓; /order/<id> shows review-reminder card ('Pesananmu sudah selesai 🎉') AND give-review button when status=selesai && !review ✓; tapping either opens the modal with star-1..star-5, review-komentar TextInput, add-review-foto, submit-review ✓; add-review-foto opens file chooser and uploads via pickAndUploadImages returning /api/files/... URL — preview appears with remove-review-foto ✓; remove-review-foto clears the preview and clicking add-review-foto again re-uploads ✓; POST body from UI = {"rating":5,"komentar":"...","foto_url":"/api/files/..."} ✓; after submit, order-review card ('Ulasan Kamu') renders 5 filled stars + comment + photo thumbnail, reminder card and give-review button disappear ✓. NotificationListener toast code present (src/components/notification-listener.tsx:80-81 emits 'Pesanan <no> selesai. Yuk beri ulasan ⭐' on socket order_status status==='selesai' for buyers). ONE FRONTEND BUG FOUND: /produk/[id].tsx review cards (lines 201-215) DO NOT render r.foto_url, so buyer-submitted review photos are NOT shown on the product detail page even though the backend correctly returns foto_url in the aggregate items (verified via curl and confirmed 0 /api/files/ images inside the 'Ulasan Pembeli' section on live). Spec explicitly asks for photo (optional) in product-detail review cards.

ui_bugs.issue: Review card does not render r.foto_url. Backend GET /api/products/{id}/reviews returns foto_url in items but the JSX (lines 201-215) only renders name, stars, komentar, created_at. Verified live: /api/products/83eb256eba3c4507bff619b294699876/reviews returns foto_url='/api/files/diana-stuff/uploads/.../bfc7957de8484822bd4330c5525a609e.jpg' but the product-detail 'Ulasan Pembeli' card shows 0 /api/files/ images. Reference: /app/frontend/app/produk/[id].tsx:201-215

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/produk/[id].tsx (~line 213, inside the review-<i> card, after {r.komentar}), render the review photo when r.foto_url is truthy, e.g. `{r.foto_url ? <Image source={{ uri: resolveImageUrl(r.foto_url) }} style={styles.reviewPhoto} contentFit="cover" /> : null}` and add a `reviewPhoto` style similar to the one used in /app/frontend/app/order/[id].tsx (`{ width: 96, height: 96, borderRadius: 12 }`). Also extend the local Reviews type so items include `foto_url?: string | null`.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1045-1065 review_order — clean: rating validation via int() + range 1..5, 404 on missing order, 403 on non-owner, sets full review object atomically. foto_url stored as-is (nullable) — good.
server.py:512-537 product_reviews — items now include foto_url = rv.get('foto_url'); shape and empty/edge behaviour preserved from iter15.

app/order/[id].tsx:87-97 submitReview mutation — resets state on success (setReviewFoto/setKomentar/setRating), invalidates the ['order', id] query so the 'Ulasan Kamu' card immediately reflects the new review; reminder disappears via `canReview = status==='selesai' && !order.review` guard — correct.

app/order/[id].tsx:99-108 onPickReviewFoto — uses same pickAndUploadImages() as bukti/chat; toasts errors; sets reviewFoto only on success. Good; but permissionDenied is not explicitly handled here (unlike onUpload) so galleri-blocked users get a generic error — minor UX nit.

app/pesanan-saya.tsx:55-58 nudge — testID=`nudge-review-${id}` gated on status==='selesai' && !review. Small tap target (icon+text row) but non-interactive nudge (visual only). Users still need to open the order to actually leave a review — acceptable and matches spec.
src/components/notification-listener.tsx:80-81 — buyer receives socket 'order_status' with status 'selesai' → toast 'Pesanan <no> selesai. Yuk beri ulasan ⭐'. Correct.
app/produk/[id].tsx:201-215 — Review card ignores r.foto_url returned by backend. This is the only spec deviation.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 pytest — submit with photo, submit without photo, rating 400s, unknown 404, non-owner 403, product-reviews foto_url present, product-reviews foto_url null)

rca_of_issue: Bug: product-detail 'Ulasan Pembeli' section drops review photos. Reproduction — (1) buyer submits a review with foto_url via POST /api/orders/{id}/review; (2) GET /api/products/{product_id}/reviews returns items[i].foto_url correctly; (3) open /produk/{product_id} → each review card renders nama, stars, komentar, created_at but no Image for foto_url. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/produk/[id].tsx:201-215 never references r.foto_url. Fix: add an <Image source={{ uri: resolveImageUrl(r.foto_url) }} /> block inside the review-<i> View when r.foto_url is truthy (mirror the pattern in /app/frontend/app/order/[id].tsx:279-282 for the 'Ulasan Kamu' card). Also update the local Reviews TypeScript type to include foto_url?: string | null.
